en: A vintage postcard-style illustration of an urban Italian street scene focused on an ornate Renaissance-style palace with arcaded windows and a balcony, identified as Palazzo Rohr. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the square; a small shop with an awning and signage is visible on the left. The title of the card is printed in red at the top.
